command: Human ABCD4 retains fatty acid transmembrane transporter activity, fatty acid beta-oxidation participation, very-long-chain fatty acid biosynthesis participation, or peroxisome organization. Adjudicate these four claims separately using their actual GO definitions, direct substrate experiments, pathway mechanism and relevant phylogenetic branches. Its demonstrated lysosomal cobalamin transport function does not alone establish loss of alternative substrates or indirect peroxisome organization. Distinguish direct negative localization assays from evidence about these activities/processes.
